recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up core FHIR source work is recommended for FHIR-33002 unless a future work-group decision changes _summary=text behavior for mandatory element subtrees or extensions.
issue_request: FHIR-33002 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked how _summary=text should treat top-level mandatory elements such as Observation.code: whether their whole subtrees, nested optional children, and extensions must be returned. The approved clarification says _summary=text returns text, id, meta, and top-level mandatory elements to keep the payload valid, while servers MAY omit elements within those subtrees as long as the resulting payload is valid; extensions may be returned, but clients should not rely on them.
initial_application: Commit 4387db82e028ca74f3cea49b90392e0c77940128 applied FHIR-33002 by rewriting the _summary value table in source/search.html and adding the approved mandatory-subtree clarification plus the extension guidance. The current source still contains that text.
additional_context: The original Zulip implementer thread raised the same Observation.code/CodeableConcept subtree question and led to the Jira. FHIR-I WGM minutes for January 2022 record the same concern, note that servers MAY omit elements from the subtree, and show the 17-0-1 Persuasive with Modification vote. Related issues FHIR-33148 and FHIR-35865 address ElementDefinition.isSummary and modifierExtension summary behavior; both already have separate audit commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because source/search.html already contains the approved _summary=text wording and extension guidance, and no later discovered decision requires changing that text for FHIR-33002.

related_jiras.note: Expands ElementDefinition.isSummary guidance for mandatory and modifier elements; already separately audited on the combined branch.
Resolves the modifierExtension summary-flag question that arose from FHIR-33002/FHIR-33148; already separately audited on the combined branch.
